ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, quadrilateral $ABCD$ is inscribed in circle $\odot O$, with $AC$ being the diameter, and point $C$ as the midpoint of the minor arc $BD$. $AB=AD$, if $\angle ACD=60^\circ$, and $AD=\sqrt{3}$, find the length of $BD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because$ $\overset{\frown}{AD}=\overset{\frown}{AD}$, $\angle ACD=60^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle ABD=\angle ACD=60^\circ$,\\
$\because$ $AB=AD$,\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle ABD$ is an equilateral triangle,\\
$\because$ $AD=\sqrt{3}$,\\
$\therefore$ $BD=AD=\boxed{\sqrt{3}}$.

In triangle ABD, AB=AD, so it is an isosceles triangle, and the base angles ∠ABD and ∠BDA are equal. Since ∠ABD=60°, then ∠BDA=60°, and thus the three angles of triangle ABD are all 60°, making it an equilateral triangle. Therefore BD=AD=√3.
